hold_text: Adds seven NEW hand-written research queue units (research/queue/blocked/RQ-20261011-9da8-01..07). Per R5/STAMP_ONLY_SURFACE a new queue unit is a registration, not a stamp, and cannot self-land; the manager merges. Everything else is Tier-1: a new skill, doc edits, a read-only extension of scripts/ops/ml_plan_status.py (+ test), checklist rows, a plan yaml and a run record. No config, order path, manifest or stage change.
why: OPERATOR DIRECTIVE 2026-10-11 ~14:25Z (voice, paraphrased closely, quoted on checklist row FRONTIER-RESEARCH): the ML mandate must not be limited to variations of models already chosen; research BETTER models and methods on a recurring basis, test genuinely different things, same for strategies. This PR makes it recurring (frontier-research skill, ml-review step 9, perf-followup Track 3, manager weekly), adds a model-family diversity check (MEASURED 2026-10-11: 75 of 96 registered models are GBDT), and files the first scan's kept ideas as pre-registered blocked units with lever rows. No model has been run; every unit carries its kill rule.
